verdict.rationale: Customer.io exposes REST APIs (Track/Pipelines/App API), OpenAPI spec, a CLI documented as giving 'AI agents and scripts full access to your workspace,' and Postman collection — all scriptable/automatable outside the UI, supporting headless/CI-style automation. However, evidence centers on AI-assistant/agent workflows and API triggering rather than explicit CI/CD pipeline examples, headless test harnesses, or exit-code/scripting conventions typical of CI tooling. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline examples or integration guides, documented non-interactive auth/scripting patterns for automated pipelines, independent hands-on confirmation of CLI use in automation contexts.
